stage0222_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I heard the news, $n.
　You're staying in Japan, right?」

stage0222_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But if the Quarter and the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ split off,
　we... won't have a mothership.」

stage0222_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$n
「We'll probably deploy directly
　from the Crusher Team's base in Izu.」

stage0222_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I... have to stay behind in Izu?
　That will be lonely...」

stage0222_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... Why not add a seat to the $$ジェニオン$$
　so I can join you in the field?」

stage0222_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$n
「I'll say it again...
　Don't do anything unnecessary.」

stage0222_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do you hate anyone intruding when you're alone
　with Miss $$スズネ$$ that much?」

stage0222_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Fine, fine, I'll keep my mouth shut...
　Now, let's work hard today... Business, business!」
